title: Harvest and Portrait
author: Yara Dunmore
blurb: Freya Nystrom, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
